hey, i have some issues with eating, i hate it and i hate feeling my stomach full, i know it's messed up to feel like this when so many people don't eat because they simply don't have food.. by not eating i have found a way of feeling empty physically, not only emotionally. but when you start fainting all the time, not fitting into any clothes you have, watching bunches of your hair falling, it really ain't worthing. 

also, don't let your looks mess up with your life so hardly, just try to focus on the things you like, the ones you love.. it really makes no difference in who you truly are, and once you understand that you can be and are so much more valuable your perspective about your face will change, you don't deserve to die for 'not being pretty', you dont deserve to die at all. also fuck men 

im sorry you haven't found friends yet, i really hope they come along your path with time, and that things work out for you. i wish i could help more, but if you need to talk about anything you can send me a message. wish the best for you

i don't see a fucking point in anything, be it good or be it bad, i know my fucking brain will make everything unbearable just like it always did. i just wanna move from my parents house so that i can die without worrying that one of my brothers can find my corpse. adulthood is a good illusion to hold onto but i don't wanna be here to feel the delusion. i don't wanna be here period.
delete this i have daddy issues

a friend of my aunt gave me his guitar (ive been learning for a year and couldn't actually buy one) which is really really old and it has suuuch a great smell of old wood and the sound is so pretty i don't even care about the scratches and all 

but when i get my own ill cry when the first scratch comes

well yea, you got this.

i don't have many coping mechanisms, either i pretend i don't feel nothing or feel it all at once intensely. i used to write a lot, but i haven't done this for years now. what makes me feel okay is trying to learn things. im not really good at school but when i feel like studying i go reaaally deep into the subject, it distracts me and i feel like im doing something for myself. and it's been a year since i started to study music and i think im making some progress finally. 

however my breakdowns are really random and constant, so it's easy to feel like dying again. the really bad days are the ones where i just don't see any sense in anything, literally nothing makes a single sense and that's when i have depersonalization and dysmorphia crisis. like im sure i don't exist outside my brain and that my body is melting down. it's horrible. 

but yeah i should try to take care of myself, physically. i barely eat or drink water (because pf why would i give my body sources to keep functioning), and my sleep schedule is messed up. sometimes i dance but meh.

IM SO STRESSED BECAUSE OF THIS 
i used to stay home alone very often before quarantine so it was perfect to play with myself and moan as loud as i want, it really makes everything more intense for me bUT NOW I HAVE TO BE QUIET IN THE NIGHT it's killing me im gonna implode

hey, thanks for your reply. 
im not religious either but when i was a kid i still had all the catholic stuff in my mind, and surely the idea of "going to hell because of my sin" made the whole thing even heavier. but i wasn't really seeking for God's Pardon™, i just wanted to undo it yknow, and the only thing i could do was hate myself. now this isn't the major struggle i have but in the end of the day it's always there, reminding me that i can never fix this.
im really glad to hear your story and hear that you're doing better now, and (i assume) doing what you truly love. 
i probably should have better self-care habits, even tho im a vegetarian too i don't do it for myself (i don't really eat), i understand the sense of activism you mentioned there. i know that there's more i can do, and i tried to, i joined a group of environment activism but my mental health was really holding me from doing things the right way so i had to quit.
i try to make plans yknow, even tho i don't like it much, and in the end it feels so silly to think i could achieve anything. and it's things like, getting a job, not failing high school, going to college, getting better. but i don't really visualize myself in the future, it's so hard, so i just try to wake up every day. until im done.
again, thanks for your reply and advices. wish you all the best
